summary: Color, clean and care for adorable little pets!
description:
Color, care, wash, and play with adorable pets! Transform Crayola’s favorite kids’ pet toy into digital companions in an app packed with creativity, coloring games for kids, and interactive pet care fun. Download for free to start collecting, coloring, nurturing, and playing in one of the best coloring games for kids who love to take care of pets.

PRACTICE EMPATHY, RESPONSIBILITY & KINDNESS WITH PET CARE
• Kids can take care of pets by grooming, feeding, bathing, and loving them in a safe, nurturing digital world
• Build empathy and emotional growth through realistic pet care activities and storytelling
• Support cognitive development with routines that help children take care of pets and practice responsibility
• Created by educators to foster memory, focus, and kindness through pet care and pretend pet play

GROW & COLLECT YOUR ADORABLE PET FAMILY
• Collect over 90 Crayola pets like cats, dogs, bunnies, and more in a growing digital universe
• Customize each pet, then take care of pets as they come to life in your own colorful world
• Encourage creativity and bonding while kids explore imaginative pet care
• Every pet has unique needs, helping children learn to take care of pets again and again

EXPLORE A 3D WORLD FULL OF COLOR, PETS & PLAY
• Discover exciting new places like the Arctic, Safari, and Main Street in immersive coloring games for kids
• Kids can take care of pets while exploring rich, interactive environments filled with new challenges
• Design props, decorate scenes, and care for your pets in endless creative ways
• Boost engagement with fresh opportunities to explore and take care of pets

CUSTOMIZE & COLOR IN FUN COLORING GAMES FOR KIDS
• Use Crayola tools to design and recolor your pets — then wash and do it all over again
• Get inspired by creative videos within this world of coloring games for kids
• Each session offers a fun new way to take care of pets while expressing artistic flair
• Save and share adorable snapshots of your custom pets

CALM, SAFE & EDUCATIONAL PET CARE PLAY
• COPPA and PRIVO certified, GDPR compliant, and built for safe family use
• Designed for toddlers and preschoolers learning to take care of pets in fun and healthy ways
• Support nurturing behavior through age-appropriate pet care play and exploration
• Ideal for families looking for meaningful coloring games for kids that promote kindness and care

BUILT FROM THE BELOVED CRAYOLA SCRIBBLE SCRUBBIE TOY
• Based on the trusted Crayola Scribble Scrubbie toy line
• Watch episodes from the official Scribble Scrubbie YouTube series
• A perfect blend of physical play and imaginative digital pet care

NEW PETS, PROPS & FEATURES EACH MONTH
• New pets to color, environments to explore, and ways to take care of pets added regularly
• Keep things fresh with new themes in monthly coloring games for kids updates
• Free to play, with optional in-app purchases or a yearly subscription for expanded access

CREATED WITH RED GAMES CO.
• Developed by a team of parents and educators focused on creativity and growth
• Named one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies in Gaming (2024)
• Explore even more creativity in Crayola Create and Play and Crayola Adventures
